hint: Drag a gate onto the grid, or press its key to choose it and Enter to place it.

description.i: Does nothing to the qubit. A placeholder that keeps the timing of the circuit.
description.x: Turns 0 into 1 and 1 into 0 — the quantum NOT.
description.y: Flips the qubit and turns its phase half a turn at the same time.
description.z: Leaves 0 as it is and reverses the sign of 1. Nothing shows until the qubit interferes.
description.h: Turns a definite 0 or 1 into an even mix of both. Usually the first gate in a circuit.
description.s: Turns the phase of the 1 part by a quarter turn.
description.sdg: Undoes S — a quarter turn of phase the other way.
description.t: Turns the phase of the 1 part by an eighth of a turn.
description.tdg: Undoes T — an eighth of a turn of phase the other way.
description.sx: Half of an X. Applied twice, it flips the qubit.
description.rx: Rotates the qubit about the X axis by an angle you choose.
description.ry: Rotates the qubit about the Y axis by an angle you choose.
description.rz: Rotates the qubit about the Z axis — its phase — by an angle you choose.
description.p: Adds a phase you choose to the 1 part, and leaves 0 as it is.
description.u: The general one-qubit gate. Three angles reach any rotation at all.
description.cx: Flips the target only when the control is 1. The usual way to entangle two qubits.
description.cz: Reverses the sign only when both qubits are 1.
description.swap: Exchanges the states of two qubits.
description.iswap: Exchanges two qubits and adds a quarter turn of phase.
description.crz: Rotates the phase of the target by your angle, only when the control is 1.
description.cp: Adds the phase you choose only when both qubits are 1.
description.ccx: Flips the target only when both controls are 1. Also called Toffoli.
description.cswap: Exchanges two qubits only when the control is 1. Also called Fredkin.
description.barrier: Nothing happens here. It marks a line the optimiser may not move gates across.
description.reset: Returns the qubit to 0, whatever it held before.
description.measure: Looks at the qubit. The mix collapses to a definite 0 or 1, and the answer goes to a classical bit.
